decisions.label: Leaf hue jitter (degrees)
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves turned up to this many degrees of hue either way from its baked variant's, by a seed of its own (Ed, 2026-10-16: "a small amount of per-tree colour jitter"). 0: every tree of a variant the same, as before. Turned on the lit colour since Ed's v3893 playtest ("no visible effect": the night's moonlight had squeezed it to a third), so these are degrees on screen; the range goes well past sense (Ed: "bigger range"): past about 30 trees read as other seasons. Live: no rebake.

decisions.label: Leaf brightness jitter
decisions.note: Each tree's leaves brightened or darkened by up to this share, by a seed of its own. 0: none. The range goes well past sense (Ed: "bigger range"): past about 0.3 the darkest trees go near black. Live: no rebake.
